statement: The capture affordance is reachable from every state without a mode change: one global keystroke on desktop, a persistent floating control on mobile, and it never asks a classification question before accepting text.
mechanismHypothesis: Capture value decays in seconds; any dialog between intent and first keystroke loses the thought. Deferring classification (type, folder, destination) to after capture moves that cost to a moment when the thought is already safe.
appliesWhen: any surface whose value depends on catching transient input
doesNotApplyWhen: compliance-bound intake where classification is legally prior (the trust-surfaces contract governs those forms)
confidenceBasis: Derived from one source-grounded positive (owner-owned Mew checkout, file:line locators) plus Mobbin counterexamples; no audience-task evidence yet, so confidence is capped below audience-proven per the M-tier rule.
reVerifyReason: Mew is under active development in the owner-local checkouts and Mobbin comparators drift with product releases; re-inspect the live surfaces and re-read global.css before continuing to cite these facts.
tierLadder: M2: live shipped-product observation (owner-owned source checkout with file:line locators, plus Mobbin live screens). M1 documentation not consulted. M3 audience-task evidence absent — no rule here may be promoted to audience-proven until a real capture task is observed.
